in_sanskrit.name: किषणकुमार
in_sanskrit.meaning: Goddess of prosperity (Lakshmi) + God of abundance (Kubera)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the embodiment of Lord Kubera and Goddess Lakshmi, the deities of wealth and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Kishankumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's manifestation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kishankumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kishankumar is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Kishan' meaning 'Lord Shiva' and 'Kumar' meaning 'manifestation' or 'youth'. This name holds significant spiritual significance in Hindu mythology, as Kishan represents the divine power and protectiveness of Lord Shiva.
